text:
maya: heads up — 40+ pods pending in gpu-workload namespace, most with `0/42 nodes are available: insufficient nvidia.com/gpu` even though we just added nodes in europe-west1 :confused:

infra-bot: Cluster Autoscaler event: scaled up nodepool-gpu-eu-west (3 -> 6) at 2024-04-09T15:12:30Z

sam: seeing the same. cluster events show a bunch of `FailedScheduling` with `Requested device plugin resource` and also a few `nodeAffinity` mismatches. odd that CA added nodes but they aren't usable. :thinking:

maya: pasting `kubectl describe pod` from one pending that should be tiny: 
```
Name: gpu-small-abc
Namespace: gpu-workload
Containers:
  app:
    requests:
      nvidia.com/gpu: 0.25
    limits:
      nvidia.com/gpu: 0.25
Events:
  Warning  FailedScheduling  2s (x18 over 5m)  default-scheduler  0/42 nodes are available: 42 Insufficient nvidia.com/gpu.
```

jonah: ah — fractional GPU requests. We rolled out the fractional allocator (MIG-split mode) to reduce waste last week, but the new eu nodepool is not labeled `gpu.redwood.io/fractional=true`, so the fractional scheduler predicate is excluding them.

lee: confirm — node labels on new nodes: 
```
$ kubectl get nodes -l nodepool=nodepool-gpu-eu-west -o jsonpath='{range .items[*]}{.metadata.name} {.metadata.labels}
'
gpu-node-eu-01 map[kubernetes.io/arch:amd64 nodepool:nodepool-gpu-eu-west topology.kubernetes.io/zone:europe-west1-b]
```
no `gpu.redwood.io/fractional` label.

sam: ohhh, CA added nodes from the standard gpu-pool (full-GPU) but our pods are marked fractional, and our fractional scheduler extender only matches nodes explicitly labeled. CA didn't respect the node template label. :facepalm:

maya: that explains the binpacking-looking fragmentation — CA created full-GPU nodes, leaving existing fractional nodes still tight. end result: lots of pending small pods while big pods can fit. cost + backlog.

jonah: immediate mitigation: add the fractional label to the new nodepool and cordon/uncordon a node to trigger kubelet re-registration (or drain/replace). I'll run a quick patch: `kubectl label node -l nodepool=nodepool-gpu-eu-west gpu.redwood.io/fractional=true`

sam: also we should adjust CA node-template labels for future scale-ups. Where is the autoscaler config stored? is it in `infra-config/cluster-autoscaler/**` git?

lee: yes, `infra-config/envs/eu/cluster-autoscaler.yaml` — it has `nodeTemplate:` but we missed adding `gpu.redwood.io/fractional: 'true'` for the MIG-enabled pool. I'll open a PR.

maya: small ask — can we also tweak the expander strategy? currently it's `random`, which picked full nodes in the other pool. `least-waste` would prefer fractional nodes for fractional requests. cost hit if we keep random.

jonah: agreed. change expander to `least-waste` in CA config and add a test to simulate mixed request sizes.

infra-bot: Alert: Network egress throughput on gpu-node-eu-02 reached 85% of quota around 15:10Z; some image pulls slowed ~30s -> contributing to readiness delays.

lee: nice catch — image pull throttling could cause new CA nodes to be NotReady longer, making them invisible to scheduler. we should pre-bake images or enable faster registry mirror for eu-west region.

sre-oncall: I'm on it — I'll add a short-term mirror rule and bump registry concurrently. also putting a low-priority batch job to pre-pull common images across the pool.

sam: follow-up: can we change the pod GPU request validation to reject fractional requests unless the nodepool supports MIG/fractional? we could add a mutating webhook that checks `nvidia.com/gpu` requests vs allowed node labels. avoids these surprises.

maya: yes please — that'd stop new workloads from being scheduled incorrectly. but still need CA fix for existing chaos.

jonah: PRs:
- lee: autoscaler nodeTemplate label + expander change (WIP)
- maya: webhook proposal doc (will link)
- sre-oncall: registry mirror pre-pull job (running)

maya: postmortem items: tagging: (1) CA node template must include fractional label for MIG pools (2) CA expander strategy changed from `random` -> `least-waste` for GPU pools (3) add pre-pull images for autoscaled nodes in region-specific registries (4) add admission webhook to validate GPU request vs node support.

lee: rolling the label and expander change now to eu cluster. will watch for pods transitioning from Pending -> Running. :rocket:

infra-bot: Cluster Autoscaler event: scaled up nodepool-gpu-eu-west (6 -> 8) at 2024-04-09T15:18:02Z

sam: nice — we're seeing Pending count drop. can we also add a periodic check that flags when >30% pending GPUs are small requests so CA operator gets an early warning?

jonah: yes, I'll add a Prometheus alert `GPUFractionalPendingRatio > 0.3 for 5m` and a runbook.

maya: thanks everyone. follow-ups in PRs and I'll own the postmortem doc.

lee: thumbs up. :thumbsup:
